name: Atta
description: Stoneground whole wheat — the flour every roti starts from.

tcm.note: Follows wheat, which TCM reads as cool and heart-calming.

ayurveda.note: Godhuma is shita, guru and snigdha — building and cooling.

unani.note: Gehun is garam-tar in desi Unani usage — the exact opposite of the Chinese reading.

histamine.note: Low; wheat's issue for most people is gluten, not histamine.

nutrition.highlight: the flour every roti starts from

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
